keyEvents.text: Antonio Vergara (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! FC Porto 1, Napoli 0. Jan Bednarek (FC Porto) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gabri Veiga with a cross following a corner.
Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Scott McTominay (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! FC Porto 1, Napoli 1. Scott McTominay (Napoli) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Gabri Veiga (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins FC Porto 1, Napoli 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Jan Bednarek (FC Porto).
Delay in match because of an injury Rasmus Højlund (Napoli).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Porto. Samu Aghehowa replaces André Silva.
Substitution, FC Porto. Santiago Giménez replaces Borja Sainz.
Substitution, FC Porto. Zaidu Sanusi replaces Martim Fernandes.
Goal! FC Porto 2, Napoli 1. Gabri Veiga (FC Porto) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Santiago Giménez with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, FC Porto. Hwang In-Beom replaces Gabri Veiga.
Substitution, FC Porto. Seko Fofana replaces Pepê.
Substitution, Napoli. Noa Lang replaces Frank Anguissa.
Substitution, Napoli. Giovane replaces Antonio Vergara.
Goal! FC Porto 3, Napoli 1. Jakub Kiwior (FC Porto) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Hwang In-Beom with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Napoli. Lorenzo Lucca replaces Matteo Politano.
Rafa Marín (Napoli) is shown the red card.
Goal! FC Porto 4, Napoli 1. Samu Aghehowa (FC Porto) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
